name: fn_book_flight
description: Book airline seats from an origin location to a destination location. The passenger count must include every traveler mentioned.

name: fn_set_alarm
description: Set an alarm at a specific time and optionally repeat it every day.

name: fn_convert_temperature
description: Convert a numeric temperature value into Celsius, Fahrenheit, or Kelvin.

name: fn_convert_distance
description: Convert a numeric distance from one unit to another.

name: fn_lookup_product
description: Find exactly one catalog product using its complete SKU identifier. Preserve all characters in the SKU.

name: fn_send_message
description: Send an exact text message to a named recipient.

name: fn_transfer_money
description: Transfer a numeric amount in a specified currency from one account to another.

name: fn_create_user
description: Create a user with a display name, age, and administrator-access setting.

name: fn_update_server
description: Change the active network port and TLS setting of a named server.

name: fn_schedule_deployment
description: Schedule a deployment for a specified date and time, without necessarily executing it immediately.

name: fn_reserve_table
description: Reserve a restaurant table using the restaurant name, guest count, time, and reservation name.

name: fn_apply_discount
description: Apply a percentage discount to exactly one product SKU.

name: fn_set_maintenance_mode
description: Enable or disable maintenance mode for a named environment.

name: fn_search_logs
description: Search logs for an exact text query with optional case-sensitive matching.

name: fn_set_brightness
description: Set a display brightness level while controlling whether the display remains enabled.

name: fn_delete_account
description: Delete an account and specify whether deletion is permanent or recoverable.

name: fn_reschedule_meeting
description: Move an existing meeting to a new room and time. Use only the final requested room and time.
